description: Builds the aim/look HUD overlay for the current camera aim mode (bars, reticles, gauges, side bars); called on look enter/update

Spawns a two-part HUD bar (front and back sprite) of kind 0..4 for the player obj (list 0x58)

Aim HUD dial sprite update: when the gauge value changes, moves the sprite around a 55-unit circle by the value

Broadcasts message 0x46 (glow flash) with key arg0 to the sprite2d list; used by the scope motion sound update
On message 0x46 for its key: sets the flash flag, a 35-frame fade and copies the glow colour floats to the colour bytes
Spawns the aim HUD gauge sprites (single-player layout) with the given colour and group
Aim HUD sprite update: points the sprite at the camera target's yaw (kind 0x9A) or pitch
Spawns the aim HUD gauge marker sprites that track the gauge value (single-player layout)
Spawns the compact aim HUD gauge sprite used in multiplayer (D_80082FA0 != 0)
When D_800BE616 is set, creates a screen tint for the player and stores the owner pointer in it
Spawns two rows of four aim HUD slot sprites (kinds D_8008FFC8) above and below the view
Slot row update: moves the row in or out vertically by the gauge value (row 4 bottom, row 5 top)

Broadcasts message 0x17 (start spout) with id arg0 (0..3) to the effect controller list
Broadcasts message 0x18 (stop spout) with id arg0 (0..3) to the effect controller list
Spout controller message handler: 0x17 spawns its spout effect if none, 0x18 releases it; then link messages
Spawns a 300-frame point-stream effect (kind 0x34/11/7/0x23) at an s16 point, sized by the source, with a 0x50 param block
Spout path update: moves each point down under gravity and drops points that fall below the floor height
Spout path update: swirls the emitter around its centre with sine wobble and emits new rising points into the ring
Spout path update: walks the point ring and pulls neighbouring points toward a set segment length
Draw handler: renders the spout's point ring as a textured strip (texture D_800AB2C0[kind], 0x1C-byte points)

Spout death handler: broadcasts message 0x23 with its id, then fxrec_die_retire
Spout death handler: broadcasts message 0x23 with its id, then fxrec_die_free
If the spout with the object's id (+0x18) covers the object's height span, sends hit 0x60019 to the object
Searches two node lists for a kind-11 effect whose params (+0x98) have id arg0; NULL if none
Effect update: advances a timer and spawns random falling drip effects (effect3d) that land on the ground below
Effect update: integrates vertical velocity with acceleration into +0x38 and grows the fade value +0x50 up to 1
Spawns a ribbon trail fxrec (0x28-byte points) following an object or a second anchor, with random length and twist
Writes the ribbon anchor position: the second anchor's +0x40 vector if given, else the object's position
Ribbon trail update: once per frame records the anchor's position as a new head point with width and side direction
Ribbon trail update: drops points past the trail length and offsets the rest by a travelling sine wave
Draws a ribbon trail: two vertices per ring point offset by the side vector, one quad per segment, flat colour
Ribbon trail message handler: forwards link messages to node_handle_link_message when its owner is set
22% chance: spawns a random ground effect node up to 2000 units in front of the player, on the floor below
Break-up effects of an object: 7 model sparks, a flash and debris ring above it and 7..10 debris pieces on the floor
Broadcasts message 0x18 with the object and its id byte to the effect controller list (removes its effects)
Spawns a 300-frame effect node (handler 0x31) on the object at its mid height with a random alpha 200..255
Ends the band effect (+0xE = -1) when the owner's animation id (+0x84) differs from the one stored at +0x2E
Draws a stretchy band between two skeleton points of the owner as 6 pinched quads with a texture
Band message handler: destroys it on owner removal (0/24), swaps its owner on message 0x2D
Object effect: at bone points of its model spawns flashes, sparks and random particles (several spawners)
Destroys the node linked at +0xA8 if any
Death handler: kills the linked node, then particle_die_retire
Death handler: kills the linked node, then particle_die_free
Spawns a 300-frame object point trail controller (handler 0x48) on point arg1 of the object (D_8008FFD0)
Point query 0 of D_8008FFD0: object position with y = +0x180 + 8
Point query 1 of D_8008FFD0: object matrix applied to offset 0 (100, 8, -20)
Point query 2 of D_8008FFD0: object matrix applied to offset 1 (-100, 8, -20)
Transforms offset D_800AB37C[which] by the object's matrix; 0 when it has no matrix
Per-frame update of an object point trail controller: follows the point, releases or recreates its trail effect
Point trail controller message handler: forwards link messages to node_handle_link_message
Wrapper: releases the controller's trail effect (func_151D1990)
Death handler: releases the trail effect, then func_1514933C
Death handler: releases the trail effect, then func_15149368
Detaches the controller's trail effect: marks it finished (flags 8 and 1, 40-frame fade) and clears the link
Creates the trail fxrec (0x28-byte points, handlers 0x11/0x12) for a point trail controller and links it
Path update: records the owner object's position as a new track point with speed, width 100 and side direction
Trail update: drops expired points and sets each point's width and alpha by its age along the trail
Draws a path as a textured ribbon (texture 0xBC), two vertices per point and a quad per segment, handling t wrap
Clears the owner's +0x30 link field through the path effect's params (+0x98)
Death handler: clears the owner's link, then fxrec_die_retire
Death handler: clears the owner's link, then fxrec_die_free
Spawns the textured burst and sparks used when an object is destroyed (called by object_destroy_effects)
Allocates a type-0x18 node (0x3C bytes) with id arg0 that scrolls across the screen
Marks every type-0x18 node with id arg0 for removal (+0x16 = -2)
Moves the banner by frame time, fades its alpha in/out up to 0x80, wraps its texture offset, destroys it off-screen
Draws the banner nodes matching id arg2 into the display list (texture, rectangles)
Spawns a small textured burst at a point; used by a bouncing debris object on impact

Async EEPROM write pump: on timer message writes the next 8-byte block and re-arms; returns 1 while busy
Game copy of osEepromRead: reads one 8-byte EEPROM block through the PIF
Game copy of __osPackEepReadData: builds the PIF read command for an EEPROM block
Game copy of osEepromLongRead (waits for async writes first): reads nbytes in 8-byte blocks
Game copy of osEepromWrite: writes one 8-byte EEPROM block through the PIF
Game copy of __osPackEepWriteData: builds the PIF write command for an EEPROM block
Game copy of __osEepStatus: queries the EEPROM type/status through the PIF
Demo playback: copies the next recorded 6-byte input frame (stick, buttons, frame time) to the controller state
Impact effects at a hit point by kind (bullet etc.): ricochet sound, sparks, debris or puff particle and a decal
Particle update: while its timer (+0x170) runs, wobbles the puff's y position by a sine; then restores the base position
Transforms a point by bone arg3 of the object's matrices, or returns its position raised by arg4 without a model
Spawns effect/sound `sound` at the midpoint of a and b for the object, facing its yaw relative to its parent
Creates a short (4..6 frame) warm-white light flash at a position (radius 20..32)
Creates a longer (20..30 frame) orange light flash at a position (radius 34..57)
Spawns two effects/sounds at pos for the object, from a point behind along dir or raised by half the model height
Spawns effect/sound `sound` at pos for the object, facing along dir (or 0 without dir)
Starts a streak/beam effect from a point along a direction attached to an object bone (scale, alpha, flags)
Broadcasts message 0x3C with the object and its id byte (removes its point effects)
Spawns event 0x41 kind 0x35 with a 0x20-byte record holding the object, kind and its bone point for that kind
Update of the object point effect: follows the bone point and emits smoke particles along its movement
Point effect message handler: 0x3C for its object destroys it, 4 clears its flag 1, others go to func_15149514
Smoke particle update: wobble offset from its data (+0xA8) and damping of its velocity
Spawns the point effects of bone points 0 and 1 of the object (object_point_effect_spawn kinds 0, 1)
Applies a hit to an object: spark for some body kinds, wears the shield count, impact effects and hit message
Weapon fired: decrements the control block's ammo (+0x24) if positive and increments its shot count (+0x1AA)
Searches the impact point/target along the aim ray from the object's model for a weapon (results via pointers)
Starts camera wobble preset arg4 at a position with given strengths for every player's camera
Requests a rumble (random duration arg4..arg4+arg5, distance falloff from a position) on every player's controller
Spawns a smoke cloud at pos with a fixed emitter block (9 puffs over 3 frames)
Explosion effects at pos: smoke cloud, orange light flash and a spark shower
Transforms points a/b by an object bone and starts the streak effect at a along b - a
For mouth 0/1 computes the aim point and target, stores the far point and casts the aim ray
Mouth point of the object: a point transformed by a bone, or its position offset 49 up and 34 sideways
Tests a segment against all live objects as spheres; returns a mask with bit i cleared for each hit object
Allocates a double vertex buffer for slot arg1 on first use and returns the half for the current frame
Frees the four per-slot vertex buffers of an effect
Framebuffer ghost effect: draws a copy of the frame buffer (saved image or current buffer) into the display list
Averages neighbouring RGBA5551 pixels of the frame buffer rows (blur pass) when the ghost effect is on
Draws the saved ghost image (D_800BE570) as textured rectangles with alpha arg3
Sets the framebuffer ghost/blur strength and mode (D_800BE574/575); frees the saved image when turned off
Renders the framebuffer ghost/blur overlay for the frame when enabled (or in levels 0x32/0x33)
In levels 50/51 only, spawns the object's sprite burst (obj_sprite_burst_spawn)
Spawns the sparkle effect of a spinning scenery pickup at its position (fixed emitter block)
Money pickup collected: spawns a model effect and a "$ amount" popup record whose amount depends on event 0x83
Builds the popup matrix: yaw facing the camera, 120 units above the owner, scaled by 0.551
Prints "$ %d" above the owner with fading-in alpha; returns 0 once the owner is gone
Popup record message handler: forwards link messages to node_handle_link_message
Sets segment 8 (opaque or translucent table by alpha) and loads two sprite texture parts for a banner sprite

Effect-carrier message handler: forwards to the kind's handler in D_80090044 when there is one
Wrapper: releases the carrier's attached trail effect (func_151D7D78)
Death handler: releases the attached trail, then func_1514933C
Death handler: releases the attached trail, then func_15149368
Broadcasts message 0x3D with the object and its id byte (removes its glow trails)
Spawns an effect carrier on a character bone point (point arg1, check kind arg2) for its glow trail

Glow check: clears the active bit when the object's animation (+0x84) is 0
Glow check: clears the active bit when the object's +0xAD byte is set
Detaches the carrier's trail effect: marks it finished (flags 8 and 1, 20-frame fade) and clears the link
Creates the glow trail fxrec at the carrier's position and links it (+0x28)
Trail update: advances each ring point with gravity (func_151D8CC8); head = oldest point; ends when finished
Trail update: follows the carrier position and emits new ring points along the movement; 0 when inactive

Draw handler: renders the glow trail ring as a textured strip of quads
Advances a point's y by velocity * dt + a * dt^2 and adds acceleration to the velocity
Clears the carrier's link field (+0x28) through the trail's params (+0x98)
Death handler: clears the carrier link, then fxrec_die_retire
Death handler: clears the carrier link, then fxrec_die_free
Returns 1 if any player in the mask has a controller with a rumble pak (D_800BED64), else 0
Creates a rumble record for the players in the mask unless paused/blocked or no pak; copies its params
Rumble record update: counts down its duration, runs its strength callback and starts/stops the motors on change
Stops the rumble motor of every player in the record's mask (func_1501C15C)
Death handler: stops the record's motors, then node_retire
Death handler: stops the record's motors, then node_unlink_free
Strength callback: rumble falloff by the player's distance from the record's position (+0x18)
Sets rumble strength from the distance between a point and a player: full inside lo, fading out over the range
Rumble record message handler: messages 0x58 and 0x47 destroy it
Broadcasts message arg1 with arg0 to the rumble record list (D_800AB6E0)
Sets the rumble-block flag and broadcasts message 0x58 to remove every rumble record (level load)
Bright flash effects at a point: sparks, glow sprite, small light flash and a short white screen flash
Optionally plays the flash effects, then spawns a smoke emitter node at the point for arg1 frames
Smoke emitter update: accumulates time and emits random rising smoke particles
Resets the 0x1C settings bytes D_800E1010 to their defaults D_800901F4
Resets each settings byte outside its [min, max] range to its default (after a bad save checksum)
Returns ~arg0 (helper used by the pause menu's cartridge check)

Game mode 0 handler: counts play time, shows the time limit and runs the pause menu (resume / quit / restart)
Mode handler of the intro sequence: hides player 0, lets a button skip ahead, then starts level 0x21 in mode 1
Clears the menu timers and blink state and enters the title menu (func_151DED3C)
Sets the fade speed to 4, clears the fade and requests the options load unless D_800901D0 is set
Starts level 0x1D in mode 3 (title menu) with a pending scene start and resets the menu record's page state
Empty game-mode handler

Multiplayer helper returning an s8 per player/slot (used for slot types in mode 8 and team page scores)

Draws and edits the settings list (ring or column layout) with cursor arrows and value fades
Mode 5 handler: waits for input or the intro scene to end, then fades into menu_game_start

Resets the player order and fade, then starts level 0x1D in mode 3 (title menu)
Mode handler: fade and blink update; after 1000 frames or any input fades back to the title menu

Resets the controller-to-player order D_800843F0 to 0, 1, 2, 3
Ping-pongs the blink value D_800E0FC7 by 8 per tick between 0 and 255
Clears D_800E0EBC if set (level load)
Returns D_80090168 (free-for-all match flag)

Returns the player's team (D_800E1030) in multiplayer or menu modes, else the player index
Returns the number of human players (D_80090130, or D_8008FD8C with D_800E101B under 5)

Applies the sound mode (the N64 build also ran an anti-tamper code checksum)

Clears the four menu character slot pointers and D_80090124
